title: ZET remediation-plan.json
description: Output contract of ZET (decision layer). Owned by ZET; GER (remediation layer) refers to it with a pinned schema_version. status: draft is an unfinished draft that GER does not accept. Unknown fields are rejected (strict). 1.1 adds relation / finding_path / group / evidence / followup to action and scope to the plan (extended remediation operations). 1.0 plans (chmod only) remain valid.

schema_version.description: ZET 0.2 and later write 1.1. 1.0 is for backward compatibility (GER runs chmod only)

plan_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the body without plan_hash (A-6). Finalized plans only

now_override.description: A plan made by draft / finalize with --now (time override for tests only). GER accepts it only with GER_ALLOW_NOW_OVERRIDE=1. Omitting it means false

level_effective.description: Severity after raising it by the SkillPact rules (A-3). The input level is never changed

skillpact.description: Summary of the finding's skillpact. Added by finalize (GER rechecks I-5 / I-6 / I-7 from the plan alone)

target.description: Target of the operation. null only for a checklist (a finding whose path is null: crontab, environment variables and so on)

relation.description: Relation between target and the finding's path (closed set). ZET checks the lexical conditions; GER independently checks the same relation on the current file system. none only when target is null. plist_program / preload_lib / unit_wants are Phase 2 (not supported by GER yet)

finding_path.description: The finding's path. Copied by finalize

group.description: Combines several findings on the same target into one transaction (one write). type, target and evidence.hash must match

evidence.description: State of finding_path at detection. Copied by finalize (the findings 1.1 evidence; with 1.0 derived from whether evidence_hash is the hash of detail). detail cannot be compared, so GER uses the preview hashes pinned in params

followup.description: Manual work that must follow an automatic remediation (incident response, secret rotation, launchctl bootout and so on). ZET decides from the finding which ones are required; a missing one is I-13

params.description: The shape per operation is actions.schema.json (owned by GER, copied with a pinned version to schemas/vendor). Drafts allow select (ger preview replaces it with concrete values)

reversible.description: Determined by ZET from the operation type (A-4). Added by finalize

skillpact_effects.description: skillpact.declared_effects of the finding (A-4). Added by finalize

evidence_hash.description: For plan 1.0 compatibility (1.1 uses evidence). The finding's evidence_hash (ZES rule: SHA-256 of the contents for a regular file of 100 MB or less, SHA-256 of path, size and mtime above 100 MB). Added by finalize. GER compares it with the current file in G-7

scope.description: The scan scope covered by the approval (GER G-9). roots are the ZES scan roots (scan_roots of findings 1.1, or policy.scope of the triage input), home is ZES_HOME. The target of an action that changes files must be under roots or home. The quarantine store cannot be under roots

effect.description: The 6 SkillPact 0.8 effects (the same as $defs.effect in the ZES findings.schema.json)

signed.description: Whether there is a signature field (not verified)

constraints.description: Notes for drafts only. check does not trust these values from the plan and recomputes them from the input

suggested_actions.description: ZET's suggestions (finding → remediation mapping). label auto is an operation that GER performs automatically; checklist is manual work only. The decision maker decides whether to adopt one
